experiment: 10-law shared-head generalist (real vs dummy law signature), 3 seeds each
hypothesis: The LCA benefit (1 - curve_err_real / curve_err_dummy) is monotone non-decreasing in equation ambiguity, where ambiguity(i) = max_j |Q_i intersect Q_j| / |Q_i| is computed from the physical-quantity token vocabulary alone -- before any training.

excluded.rc: normalized trajectory is parameter-invariant (structural degeneracy): neither condition can improve it, so benefit is uninformative regardless of ambiguity

falsifiable_statements: rho(ambiguity, benefit) > 0 over the 9 non-degenerate laws with exact permutation p < 0.05
leave-one-law-out predicted benefit ranks correlate with measured benefit ranks (rho_OOS > 0 with p < 0.05)
pendulum and spring -- whose ambiguity rises from 0.5/0.0 to 1.0 when kepler/damped enter the law set -- show a positive benefit in the 10-law model
